name: Samsung Life Insurance Co., Ltd.
summary: Samsung Life Insurance Co., Ltd. is a leading South Korean insurer with a global footprint, primarily operating in the life insurance sector. Its operations span domestic and international markets, encompassing not just insurance but also credit card services, installment financing, and leasing. The company delivers a comprehensive suite of insurance products, including life, term, health, accident, pension, savings, child, and direct policies. Beyond insurance, it provides various financial services such as insurance contract loans, credit loans, mortgage financing, and retirement pension solutions. Additionally, its activities extend to real estate leasing, investment and trust management, specialized credit financing, facilitating collective and real estate investment vehicles, and supporting new technology business ventures. Founded in Seoul, South Korea, in 1957, Samsung Life Insurance maintained a significant operational presence as of December 31, 2021, with 88 local divisions and 590 branches.
